overview_description.description:
XtalPi is a pharmaceutical technology company that is reinventing the industry’s approach to drug research and development with its Intelligent Digital Drug Discovery and Development (ID4) platform. Through its tightly interwoven quantum mechanics, artificial intelligence, and high-performance cloud computing algorithms, the ID4 platform enables pharmaceutical companies to increase their efficiency, accuracy, and success rate at critical stages of drug R&D. By accelerating the pace of drug discovery and development, XtalPi aims to contribute to a healthier society worldwide.

Founded in 2014 by a group of quantum physicists at MIT, XtalPi has since grown into an elite team of researchers with multi-disciplinary expertise in physics, chemistry, pharmaceutical R&D, and algorithm design. XtalPi has received much recognition for its cutting-edge technologies, its innovative solutions, and the breadth of potential applications of its offerings across the pharmaceutical value chain, which has allowed it to gain industry approval and establish strategic partnerships with several top international pharmaceutical companies.

product.name: AI Autonomous Experiment Platform
product.description: An integrated platform combining AI models, laboratory robotics, digital workflows, and scientific data infrastructure to automate experiments and create closed-loop design–execution–feedback cycles.

product.name: Small-Molecule Drug Discovery Platform
product.description: An integrated AI and laboratory-services platform for small-molecule discovery, covering target research, hit discovery, lead optimization, and preclinical candidate development.

product.name: AI Molecular Design
product.description: A computational chemistry offering that uses patent data, molecular generation, property prediction, and automated validation to identify and prioritize drug candidates.

product.name: Xtalgazer® Drug Solid-State R&D Platform
product.description: A computational and experimental platform for pharmaceutical solid-form development, including crystal-structure prediction, solid-form screening, crystallization strategy, and crystal morphology prediction.

product.name: XmartChem® Intelligent Synthesis Workstation
product.description: A robotic workstation for automated chemical synthesis that performs controlled reagent handling, reactions, and experiment workflows with standardized, high-throughput execution.

product.name: PatSight Drug Patent Mining Platform
product.description: A software platform for extracting, structuring, labeling, and analyzing pharmaceutical patent information to support chemical-space exploration and drug research.
